source.title: Proposed Cavite Province Land Reclamation and Development Project: Island A (247.28 hectares) - Environmental Impact Statement
source.provider: Environmental Management Bureau, DENR; proponent: Cavite Provincial Government

tableLead.title: List of Fish species caught in inner Bacoor bay within Island A
tableLead.basis: The official PDF search index exposes the table-of-contents entry only.

source.projectLocationContext: The official EMB public-hearing index describes Island A as along Bacoor Bay and coastal waters of Cavite City and Kawit. The project footprint is not a fish habitat boundary or bay geometry.

decision.action: Retain this as a retrieval lead for Bacoor Bay only; do not make species assertions from the table title or index snippet.
reasons: The table title identifies inner Bacoor Bay, but no row-level taxon content was directly reviewed.
The table's collection dates, locality boundaries, sampling gear, identification procedure, specimens and rights cannot be verified from its indexed table of contents.
A proposed reclamation project footprint is not used as bay or fish-survey geometry.

nextAction: Obtain an accessible, authorized copy of the official EIS and inspect the full Table 2.2-49 context, source notes, dates, gear and identification basis. Resolve item-specific reuse terms before deriving records; then crosswalk only source-supported names and keep historical catch evidence distinct from current presence.
